title: The rate-determining step
caption: In a two-step reaction the slower step is the one with the higher transition state. Here the first step is fast and the second slow, so the second step is rate-determining and the rate equation reflects the species in it.
alt: Profile with two humps; the second is higher.
description: Step 1: a low barrier, fast, forming the intermediate.
Step 2: the higher barrier, slow: rate-determining.
